title: Freaky Edition Subtitle
description: Replaces the Minecraft "Java Edition" subtitle with "Freaky Edition"
body:
Freaky Edition Subtitle replaces the default **Java Edition** text on the Minecraft title screen with the text **Freaky Edition**.
